-- Botão FECHAR

-- Título
local TextLabel_5 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TextLabel_5.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TextLabel_5.Parent = Frame_1
TextLabel_5.Position = UDim2.new(0.061, 0, -0.008, 0)
TextLabel_5.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, 0)
TextLabel_5.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
TextLabel_5.Text = "FlyVix"
TextLabel_5.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TextLabel_5.TextSize = 46
local UIStroke_12 = Instance.new("UIStroke", TextLabel_5)
UIStroke_12.Thickness = 4.3

-- ============ ESCALA (aplica em tudo de uma vez) ============
-- UIScale comprime o menu inteiro mantendo o design 100% intacto
local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
uiScale.Scale = UI_SCALE
uiScale.Parent = Frame_1

-- ============ LÓGICA DE FLY ============

local flyActive = false
local displayValue = 0
local SPEED_STEP = 1
local MULTIPLIER = 100
local MAX_DISPLAY = 50

local flyConnection = nil
local currentBV = nil
local currentBG = nil
local originalPlatformStand = false
local originalGravity = workspace.Gravity

local function updateCounter()
    counter_1.Text = tostring(displayValue)
end

local function getRealSpeed()
    return displayValue * MULTIPLIER
end

local function createFlyInstances()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return false end

    if currentBV then currentBV:Destroy() end
    if currentBG then currentBG:Destroy() end

    currentBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    currentBV.Name = "FlyVix_BV"
    currentBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    currentBV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    currentBV.P = 1250
    currentBV.Parent = hrp

    currentBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    currentBG.Name = "FlyVix_BG"
    currentBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    currentBG.P = 30000
    currentBG.D = 500
    currentBG.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    currentBG.Parent = hrp

    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    return true
end

local function removeFlyInstances()
    if currentBV then currentBV:Destroy() currentBV = nil end
    if currentBG then currentBG:Destroy() currentBG = nil end

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = originalPlatformStand
        end
    end
    workspace.Gravity = originalGravity
end

-- Direcao via joystick nativo (mobile) / WASD (PC)
local function getMoveDirection()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end

    local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection
    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
        return moveDir.Unit
    end

    if not IS_MOBILE then
        local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
            or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveVector = moveVector - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
            return moveVector.Unit
        end
    end

    return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

local function startFly()
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() end

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            originalPlatformStand = humanoid.PlatformStand
        end
    end
    originalGravity = workspace.Gravity

    if not createFlyInstances() then return end

    workspace.Gravity = 0

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flyActive then return end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        if not currentBV or not currentBV.Parent
            or not currentBG or not currentBG.Parent then
            createFlyInstances()
            if not currentBV then return end
        end

        local dir = getMoveDirection()
        currentBV.Velocity = dir * getRealSpeed()
        currentBG.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    removeFlyInstances()
end

local function toggleFly()
    flyActive = not flyActive
    if flyActive then
        Frame_4.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 255, 0)
        Frame_3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 0)
        TextLabel_1.Text = "I"
        startFly()
    else
        Frame_4.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(169, 255, 179)
        Frame_3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 255, 0)
        TextLabel_1.Text = "O"
        stopFly()
    end
end

-- ============ EVENTOS ============

actid_1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

speedPlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    displayValue = math.min(displayValue + SPEED_STEP, MAX_DISPLAY)
    updateCounter()
end)

speedMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    displayValue = math.max(displayValue - SPEED_STEP, 0)
    updateCounter()
end)

cloze_1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    stopFly()
    ScreenGui_1:Destroy()
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if flyActive then
        stopFly()
        flyActive = false
        Frame_4.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(169, 255, 179)
        Frame_3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 255, 0)
        TextLabel_1.Text = "O"
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        toggleFly()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
        displayValue = math.min(displayValue + SPEED_STEP, MAX_DISPLAY)
        updateCounter()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        displayValue = math.max(displayValue - SPEED_STEP, 0)
        updateCounter()
    end
end)

updateCounter()

print("[FlyVix] Menu carregado! Design original, escala mobile = " .. UI_SCALE)
print("Display 1 = velocidade 100 | Passo 1 em 1 | Comeca em 0")
if IS_MOBILE then
    print("Use o JOYSTICK do Roblox pra voar")
else
    print("WASD = mover | Space = subir | Ctrl/Shift = descer")
end
